path.data-reference-role: NONPRINTED coordinate reference, not physical matter/air or a printed surrounding frame.

path.data-subject-role: Adult female California sea lion lateral outline, upright neck, narrow upward snout, one long visible foreflipper and near hindflipper. Far foreflipper occluded by trunk.
Second hindflipper visible beyond rear body; joined at exact two contour roots.
Near-side visible external ear flap; far ear occluded.
Visible near-side eye, no extra eye from ball.
Sparse closed mouth line below snout contact.
One introduced ball touches underside at650,200; static contact lesson, not real performance.
